info.name: TransferZero Account Debits API Logs API
Fetch a list of API logs

params.name: page
params.description: The page number to request (defaults to 1)

params.name: per
params.description: The number of results to load per page (defaults to 10)

params.name: created_at_from
params.description:
Start date to filter recipients by created_at range
Allows filtering results by the specified `created_at` timeframe.

Example: `/v1/recipients?created_at_from=2018-06-06&created_at_to=2018-06-08`

params.name: created_at_to
params.description:
End date to filter recipients by created_at range
Allows filtering results by the specified `created_at` timeframe.

Example: `/v1/recipients?created_at_from=2018-06-06&created_at_to=2018-06-08`

items.docs: Returns a list of API logs. Also includes information relating to the original request.

params.name: API Log ID
params.description:
ID of the API log to retrieve

Example: `/v1/api_logs/00485ce9-532b-45e7-8518-7e5582242407`

items.docs: Returns a single API log based on the API log ID.
